verdict.rationale: The only machine-oriented rails in the pack are link titles. There is a 'Data and Image Subscriptions' offering and a Farm Product Monthly Subscription, which suggest bulk data delivery but not transacting. There is also a Department of Revenue link to 'Resources for tax professionals and software providers', which comes from a sibling agency rather than the filing registry. The filing portal itself is a human 'Sign In / Create an Account' credential rail. Missing for 10: a documented system-to-system filing channel (system accounts, transmitter or batch-filer program), a published enrollment path, technical specs or format docs for the subscriptions, and any hands-on corroboration.
